summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Teck Resources Ltd. reporting a routine dividend declaration. The board declared an eligible dividend of $0.125 per share on Class A common and Class B subordinate voting shares, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 15, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a standard capital return event through a recurring dividend, not a special situation. There are no deal terms.
